title: Week Legacy Boundary Refactor and Slice Decomposition

waves.title: Implement Week ownership boundary and compatibility split
waves.goal: Land the Week-owned backend seed boundary, split frontend compatibility reconstruction, add Week E2E guardrails, and close the slice with targeted packet-local evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Week seed ownership is moved into a Week-owned helper module and the direct private-helper import from report_workflow.py is removed from week_brief_service.py.
Week prompt-context wiring still works after the seed-boundary extraction.
Canonical Week mapping stays in frontend/lib/week-brief.ts, while compatibility reconstruction is isolated in frontend/lib/week-brief-compat.ts.
The visible /week product path stays canonical-only and unchanged.
Verifier records an explicit packet-local WeekBrief observability verdict of clean or degraded-but-expected.

Any extraction from backend/app/main.py beyond documenting the next boundary.
Unifying backend/app/services/week_map.py with the new Week-owned seed helper in a later slice.
